newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to wobble then head towards 4,970.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to wobble then head towards 4,970.

text.p: The London stock market will wobble about on Friday as profit-takers, then bargain hunters take turns to enter the market, technical analysts said.
Oil stocks will provide a steadying influence and the overall tendency will be for the FTSE 100 to drift up towards 4,970, they added.

The market stopped short of the psychologically important 5,000 level and may not be ready to cross above it just yet but profit-takers will not be in sufficient numbers to send the FTSE reeling back too far today.
By 0726 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 5.7 at 4,954.7.
A daily bar chart of the index since late last week shows the market currently moving within the confines of two diverging trendlines connecting the FTSE's intra-day highs and lows.
Both lines have steep gradients and the vertical distance between them reflects the market's volatile rise since last week.

This volatility may ease later in the day following the 0930 GMT expiry of July FTSE index options contracts leaving the index free to travel within a 40-point range without stepping outside of the trendline limits -- which are currently between 4,460 and 5,000.

There is scope for the market to develop an upward bias once the options expiry is out of the way but it may not be sufficient to lift the index too far as trading volumes may fail to match recent turnover,analysts said.
Total daily turnover over the past two days has averaged 1.08 billion shares.
